fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Game working memory (map, battle and screen state). Rebuilt at power-on; not part of the save (no byte here is read before the game rewrites it)
fields.evidence: boot reads-before-write on two saves cover only 1e00-1f40; bytes below change every step

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Save signature, the letters MS
fields.evidence: code 9000:17b6 compares 4 bytes with ROM template e42f:0000; written at first power-on with an on-screen init message

fields.name: signature version
fields.meaning: Second half of the signature, bytes 01 03; any mismatch in the 4 signature bytes makes the game wipe and rebuild the whole save block
fields.evidence: code 9000:17b6 + template; signature valid in 218 of 219 saves (only blank power-on lacks it)

fields.name: BGM on
fields.meaning: BGM/music switch (1 = on, 0 = off); music calls are skipped when 0
fields.evidence: code 8000:008f gate; option-mode row 0 ("bgm"); play: toggling the bgm row flips only this byte and the screen shows off

fields.name: sound effects on
fields.meaning: Sound effect switch (1 = on, 0 = off)
fields.evidence: code 8000:009f gate; option-mode row 1 ("se"); play: toggling the se row flips only this byte

fields.name: ending seen
fields.meaning: Set to 1 after the story ending; lets the mode menu cursor reach extra entries
fields.evidence: code 9000:1657 sets 1 after final stage; 8000:a5cc menu limit; 0 in every natural save

fields.name: game mode
fields.meaning: Mode last chosen on the mode menu: 0 story, 1 trial, 2 duel, 3 options, 4 extra options page (after the ending)
fields.evidence: code 8000:a101 (from menu cursor); play: entering option mode writes 3; menu shows story/trial/duel/option

fields.name: last battle won
fields.meaning: 1 after a stage is cleared, 0 when a stage starts, is lost, or a mode is picked
fields.evidence: code 8000:5223 (set 1 on clear), 8000:d846/5010/a104 (0); stage setup reads it with the stage number

fields.name: current stage / result
fields.meaning: Stage being played (0-15); 0x10 = all 16 cleared, 0x13 = game over (0x11/0x12 handled at boot but never written)
fields.evidence: code 8000:d843 (stage start), 8000:500b (0x13 on loss), 9000:1631/01b8 (0x10); play: GAME OVER flips 00 to 13

fields.name: active file
fields.meaning: Number of the save file in use (1-8; 9 while duelling with the guest record); 0 before any file is made
fields.evidence: code 8000:ca2d/ca04; play: file creation writes 01

fields.name: unit unlock flags
fields.meaning: One byte per unit type 0-41: bit 7 set = type can be picked on the unit screen (others show as X). Types 0-7, 13, 14 open from the start; beating story stages 4/8/12/16 opens types 8/9/10/11 and the ending opens 12
fields.evidence: code 8000:bed3 reads 1e0b+type, 8000:518c and 9000:162c set bit7; ROM table 0xa79fa; template matches saves

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No reader or writer found; zero in the template and in all 219 saves
fields.evidence: ROM operand scan; all-saves check

fields.name: opponent record
fields.meaning: Record 0: the current stage opponent, same layout as a file record; rebuilt from ROM tables when a stage starts (TP and stage bytes set to FF, second-round byte untouched); in duel mode the link foe overwrites type/HP/ENG
fields.evidence: code 8000:d82a; play: filled when story stage 1 began (type 0f = table byte 0x10 - 1); 8000:cf48 duel writer

fields.name: file 1 type
fields.meaning: Unit type 0-41 (FF = empty file); also picks the names shown (type 0 = KNIGHT, pilot SHUNER)
fields.evidence: code 8000:ca3e writes chosen type; 8000:b67e finds file by type, 8000:b6ab finds free slot by FF; natural save shows KNIGHT/SHUNER

fields.name: file 1 second round
fields.meaning: 0 = first round of 16 stages, 1 = second round with harder opponents; flips when stage 16 has a mark (marks then reset)
fields.evidence: code 8000:b5ec toggles at load; 8000:d862 picks opponent table +16 when set

fields.name: file 1 HP
fields.meaning: Hit points
fields.evidence: code 8000:ca4b copies from ROM unit table; natural save = 08, screen HP 08

fields.name: file 1 ENG
fields.meaning: Energy
fields.evidence: code 8000:ca55; natural save = 20, screen ENG 20

fields.name: file 1 TP
fields.meaning: Upgrade points (TP); the stage mark earned is added on clear, capped at 99
fields.evidence: code 8000:ca5f (start value), 8000:51d8/5207 add rank; natural save = 20, screen TP 20

fields.name: file 1 equipment
fields.meaning: 8 equipment slots, one item id each (FF empty): 00 MOVE, 01 SONOR, 04 VULCAN, 0A STUN-G
fields.evidence: code 8000:ca66 copy from ROM unit table; natural save bytes match screen items; 25 names in ROM

fields.name: file 1 stage marks
fields.meaning: 16 bytes, one per stage: best mark 0-4 (0 = not cleared; kept only if better than before). Rank: clean win 4 (fast) / 3 (slow), costly win 2 / 1; fast means a battle counter under 64
fields.evidence: code 8000:5140-5221 (rank and store), 9000:1735 furthest stage, 8000:b5ec clamps to 4; natural save all 0, stage list empty

fields.meaning: Unit type 0-41 (FF = empty file); also picks the names shown
fields.evidence: same layout as file 1 (code addresses record 0x1e3c+n*0x1d, n=1..8); empty FF in natural save
